question: What Is an Earth Leakage Relay and How Does It Work?
body_html:
An earth leakage relay (ELR) measures the residual current of a circuit through a core balance CT (CBCT) and trips the breaker via a shunt trip or undervoltage release when leakage exceeds the set value. All phases and neutral pass through the CBCT, so healthy currents cancel, while leakage returning through earth leaves a residual signal.

Settings typically range from 30 mA to 30 A with adjustable delay. A 30 mA setting must be instantaneous, and the PE conductor must stay outside the CBCT.
